title: Excellent tour
text: Was a wonderful tour!  Excellent tour guide, very knowledgeable.  Saw a lot of Gaudis architecture and works of art.  Loved seeing the city with someone who knew so much about the culture.
author: SHIRLEY_V

title: Great tour great guide !
text: This was the perfect tour. We are only in Barcelona for two days. This gave us a huge overview of the city. The different neighborhoods and great spot for photos. Our guide was awesome. Kind generous with his knowledge of the city and life in it. I would highly recommend doing this before you spend too much time there because it gives you a great idea of where you’d like to visit moving forward. This is a great choice.
author: Mary_F
